_how: Sam's projects that passed the 20-check Stress Test. RULE (Sam, 14-15 Nov 2026): each type (villa / townhouse / apartment) shows 6 projects (Sam 18 Nov: 6 per type): 2 pinned top-developer projects (pin: true) that never move unless Sam moves them or they sell out (available: false), plus the 4 most recently added non-pinned projects (by 'added' date), which rotate as Sam posts a new project reel each day: add the reel's project here with today's date and it takes a rotating slot, pushing the oldest rotating one off the page (it stays in this file). 'dld' = DLD project numbers (the page reads construction %, escrow bank and completion date from ../checklist/data/projects.json); leave [] if not registered; eoi true = EOI / pre-launch. REEL PAGE: samsuryarealty.com/picks/?p=<slug>&want=brochure|plan|layout shows one project: 'summary' (what the reel said), stills from 'gallery', live DLD badge, then WhatsApp buttons for brochure / payment plan / floor plans with the one the commenter asked for first, then a link to all picks. Each project reel gets 3 post-only comment rules: BROCHURE/DETAILS/PRICE -> want=brochure, PAYMENT -> want=plan, LAYOUT/FLOOR -> want=layout. CARD (Sam 18 Nov): price = launch 'from' price, bed = unit it buys, plan = payment plan text, hl = 2 highlights (community selling point + what buyers like). Missing price/plan shows 'ask me'. The 'below area price per sq ft' chip is automatic from DLD (checklist/data/psf.json) and only shows when the project is cheaper.
